sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: railroad cautions, route markers and mile posts, work zones and pavement markings
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from this section's selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge or memory.
The railroad safety list that began on the previous page ends at the top of the first selected page; only the items printed there are taught [A01].
The interstate, national and state route marker images and the sample mile post on the first selected page come through the extracted text as loose labels and numbers; no marker image or its number is taught (verify AZ-WORKZONE-D-MARKERS) [A01].
The pavement-marking drawings and lane-arrow pictures on the last selected page are described in words only; no drawing is reproduced [A03].
The painted-curb paragraph on the last selected page stops before the curb colors, which continue on the next page; only the general rule is taught here [A03].
Originality: every statement is reworded from the cited page; no manual sentence, table, image or official test question is reproduced.
Exam numbers: the manual prints no question count, passing score, item format or time limit, so none is stated anywhere in this section; the typed debts live in part A.
External review: restating published Arizona traffic and licensing rules needs no clinical or legal sign-off; none is requested.

corpus_stability.reason: The Arizona Driver License Manual carries one revision line on its contents page (Revised September 2026) and points to Arizona Revised Statutes Title 28 for current law; nothing in the selected pages signals more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: The manual shows interstate, national and state route marker images and a sample mile post whose labels are scrambled in the extracted text; read the rendered page before teaching any marker shape or color.
